argmax_encrypted_tensor: find the indices of the maximum value in an encrypted CrypTensor along a given dimension
argmin_encrypted_tensor: find the indices of the minimum value in an encrypted CrypTensor by negating and calling argmax
max_encrypted_tensor: compute the maximum value of an encrypted CrypTensor using pairwise or tree reduction methods
min_encrypted_tensor: compute the minimum value of an encrypted CrypTensor by negating and calling max
argmax_with_method: run argmax on an encrypted tensor using a configurable method like log_reduction or double_log_reduction
